constraints: 分级保留：`maa_task` 全部落库、30 天 / 300,000 条；`server` `INFO` 及以上、7 天 / 200,000 条；`maacore_debug` `WARNING` 及以上、3 天 / 50,000 条。两个维度同时生效，取更严格的一方：先按天数删，删完若仍超条数上限，按 id 升序继续删到上限以内（docs/04 §10.2）。
`maacore_debug` 只落 `WARNING` 及以上的落库阈值（配置项 `log.persist_maacore_debug_level`）与实时全量推送是 `LogHub` 的职责（M4）；本卡只实现清理任务，不改 `LogHub`、不实现日志采集（docs/04 §10.2）。
`pipeline` 保留 90 天或最近 500 条（先触发者生效）。删除时 `task` 随外键级联，`log_entry` 与 `screenshot` 的关联字段置 NULL 后由各自策略处理；不保留墓碑记录（docs/04 §10.3）。
截图文件保留 7 天，同时受总大小上限约束（默认 512 MB）。超限时按 `created_at` 升序删文件并给记录打 `deleted_at`，记录本身随流水线的保留策略一起清理；`resource/temp/screencap/` 下的 IPC 中转图保留 1 小时，且不进 `screenshot` 表（docs/04 §10.3）。

清理逻辑集中在 `services/retention_service.py`，由 APScheduler 每天 04:00 触发，另在启动后 30 秒跑一次；分批删除，不要一条 DELETE 干完（内部 LIMIT 5000，每批后 `asyncio.sleep(0.05)` 让出写锁）；空间回收靠增量 vacuum `PRAGMA incremental_vacuum(1000)`，完整 `VACUUM` 不进自动任务（docs/04 §10.4）。
verify: .venv/bin/python -c "import inspect, maa_api.services.retention_service as r; assert inspect.iscoroutinefunction(r.run_retention), 'run_retention 必须是 async'; assert r.RETENTION_CRON == '0 4 * * *', r.RETENTION_CRON; assert r.STARTUP_DELAY_SECONDS == 30, r.STARTUP_DELAY_SECONDS; src=inspect.getsource(r); assert 'incremental_vacuum' in src, '清理后必须做增量 vacuum（docs/04 §10.4）'; assert 'sleep' in src, '分批之间必须让出写锁（docs/04 §10.4）'; print('RETENTION CONTRACT OK')"

.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import asyncio, inspect, os, pathlib, tempfile, time
from datetime import timedelta
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine
from sqlalchemy.pool import NullPool
from sqlmodel import SQLModel
import maa_api.db.models  # noqa: F401
import maa_api.db.session as s
import maa_api.services.retention_service as r
from maa_api.db.models import LogEntry, Screenshot, utcnow
from maa_api.domain.enums import LogLevel, LogSource, ScreenshotBackend, ScreenshotTrigger

assert inspect.iscoroutinefunction(r.run_retention), "run_retention 必须是 async"
assert getattr(r, "RETENTION_CRON", None) == "0 4 * * *", getattr(r, "RETENTION_CRON", None)
assert getattr(r, "STARTUP_DELAY_SECONDS", None) == 30, getattr(r, "STARTUP_DELAY_SECONDS", None)

d = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
s.DB_PATH = d / "maa_api.db"
s.SYNC_URL = f"sqlite:///{s.DB_PATH}"
s.ASYNC_URL = f"sqlite+aiosqlite:///{s.DB_PATH}"
eng = create_async_engine(s.ASYNC_URL, poolclass=NullPool)
sf = async_sessionmaker(eng, expire_on_commit=False)
now = utcnow()


async def main():
    async with eng.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(SQLModel.metadata.create_all)
    img = d / "image" / "screenshot" / "20200101"
    img.mkdir(parents=True)
    old_file, new_file = img / "old.jpg", img / "new.jpg"
    old_file.write_bytes(b"x" * 10)
    new_file.write_bytes(b"x" * 10)
    tmp = d / "temp" / "screencap"
    tmp.mkdir(parents=True)
    stale_tmp, fresh_tmp = tmp / "stale.jpg", tmp / "fresh.jpg"
    stale_tmp.write_bytes(b"x")
    fresh_tmp.write_bytes(b"x")
    old_mtime = time.time() - 7200
    os.utime(stale_tmp, (old_mtime, old_mtime))
    async with sf() as ses:
        ses.add_all([
            LogEntry(source=LogSource.MAA_TASK, level=LogLevel.INFO, content="old", created_at=now - timedelta(days=40)),
            LogEntry(source=LogSource.SERVER, level=LogLevel.INFO, content="old", created_at=now - timedelta(days=10)),
            LogEntry(source=LogSource.MAACORE_DEBUG, level=LogLevel.WARNING, content="old", created_at=now - timedelta(days=5)),
            LogEntry(source=LogSource.MAA_TASK, level=LogLevel.INFO, content="new", created_at=now),
            Screenshot(trigger=ScreenshotTrigger.MANUAL, backend=ScreenshotBackend.CORE,
                       path="image/screenshot/20200101/old.jpg", format="jpeg", width=1, height=1,
                       size_bytes=10, created_at=now - timedelta(days=30)),
            Screenshot(trigger=ScreenshotTrigger.MANUAL, backend=ScreenshotBackend.CORE,
                       path="image/screenshot/20200101/new.jpg", format="jpeg", width=1, height=1,
                       size_bytes=10, created_at=now),
        ])
        await ses.commit()

    out = await r.run_retention(session_factory=sf)
    assert isinstance(out, dict), out
    for k in ("logs_deleted", "pipelines_deleted", "screenshots_deleted", "temp_files_deleted"):
        assert isinstance(out.get(k), int), (k, out)

    async with sf() as ses:
        logs = (await ses.execute(select(LogEntry))).scalars().all()
        assert {x.content for x in logs} == {"new"}, [(x.content, x.source) for x in logs]
        shots = {x.path: x for x in (await ses.execute(select(Screenshot))).scalars().all()}
        assert shots["image/screenshot/20200101/old.jpg"].deleted_at is not None, "过期截图必须打 deleted_at"
        assert shots["image/screenshot/20200101/new.jpg"].deleted_at is None
    assert not old_file.exists(), "过期截图文件必须删除"
    assert new_file.exists(), "未过期截图文件不得删除"
    assert not stale_tmp.exists(), "temp/screencap 超过 1 小时的中转图必须删除"
    assert fresh_tmp.exists(), "新鲜中转图不得删除"
    await eng.dispose()
    print("RETENTION OK", out)


asyncio.run(main())

【接口契约（M3 的 lifespan 会按这个接线）】`maa_api/services/retention_service.py` 导出：
`RETENTION_CRON = "0 4 * * *"`、`STARTUP_DELAY_SECONDS = 30`、`async def run_retention(*, session_factory=None) -> dict`；`session_factory=None` 时通过 `maa_api.db.session` 模块属性取（`from maa_api.db import session` 后用 `session.session_factory`，便于测试注入）；返回 dict 至少含 `logs_deleted` / `pipelines_deleted` / `screenshots_deleted` / `temp_files_deleted` 四个 int。
文件路径同样从 `session.DB_PATH.parent`（默认 `resource/`）推导：截图在 `<resource>/image/screenshot/`（DB 里存相对路径，见 docs/04 §5.4），IPC 中转图在 `<resource>/temp/screencap/`。不要硬编码 `resource/`，测试会把 `session.DB_PATH` 指到 tmp 目录。

【默认值 vs 校准】docs/13 §6 的「日志保留期 14 天 / 200 万条」是旧的整表口径校准索引，本卡以 docs/04 §10.2 的分级表为准（30/7/3 天 + 300k/200k/50k），把天数与条数上限写成模块级常量（便于将来按运行数据回调），不要接 `setting` 表（SettingService 属后续里程碑）。

【实现要点】顺序：日志（每个 source 各一轮，两维取严）→ 流水线（90 天/最近 500）→ 截图（7 天 + 512MB 上限，超限按 created_at 升序删文件并 `mark_deleted`）→ `<resource>/temp/screencap/` 里 mtime 超过 1 小时的文件（不进 DB）→ 每轮结束 `PRAGMA incremental_vacuum(1000)`；分批用 `LogRepository.purge` / `PipelineRepository.purge_before` / `ScreenshotRepository`（M2-07/M2-08 已交付，先读它们的签名）。日志用 logger 记录每轮摘要，异常不要吞（APScheduler 侧会记）。

【测试】`tests/services/conftest.py` 自备临时库 fixture（本仓无 pytest-asyncio，同步测试 + `asyncio.run`，engine 用 `poolclass=NullPool`）；覆盖：按天删、按条数上限删、截图文件删除 + `deleted_at` 打标、临时图 1 小时阈值、未过期文件不受影响。
